searchText: Hello, is there spec test for `onboard_builders_from_pending_deposits`, and is that already in `alpha.2`? Yes & yes. I can find it in a few minutes. Eg this one: https://ethspec.tools/#tests/v1.7.0-alpha.2/mainnet/gloas/fork/fork/pyspec_tests/fork_builder_deposit_uses_deposit_slot_epoch And everything in this file: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/tests/core/pyspec/eth_consensus_specs/test/gloas/fork/test_gloas_fork_onboard_builders.py Thanks! That's really helpful Hello, before Gloas, when we receive an attestation for a block root we haven' t seen we request it. When we see a block that builds on a block we haven' t seen we request it. After Gloas, when we receive a block that builds on top of a payload we haven' t seen we request it. What I **haven' t seen specified** is that when we receive an attestation for a past block with index 1 and we do not have the payload, **we should request the payload by root** obtained from the bid from the block. This may actually be more costly than usual. For Prysm this is trivial though cause we track this on Forkchoice anyway But this should be specified IMO, I may have missed this and probably someone already took care of adding this sentence in the right validator.md or whatever guide it belongs https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4939 Nice, looks good to me. Will merge after getting at least one other client to approve it. This cannot merge as-is Oh. What's the issue? FYI, <@363800010518822915> the title needs to be <= 68 chars. As phrased I think this requires https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4918 Otherwise the client would be ignoring attestations that it is forced to process Also the wording is incorrect for P2P it should be IGNORE , the payload was seen. ... and then write up the rest. I have ignore. i dont understand "the payload was seen. ... and then write up the rest." or what difference that makes if we put payload was seen first Are you still working on this PR? There are some failing tests. Also, FYI I just merged master into your branch, so do a `git pull` before fixing anything. Vacations, only working on whatever I broke in Prysm already 🙂 Also I opened that one as temporary to see what Francesco thinks. If that one will merge I can fix the tests when I get back does dora work with the latest changes to execution payload bid? im seeing the following error message `time="2026-02-18T19:33:05Z" level=warning msg="beacon block stream failed to decode execution_payload_bid event: invalid JSON: blob KZG commitments root missing" client=1-geth-lighthouse service=cl-pool` that looks outdated It should work 🤔 I know that <@412614104222531604> got Consensoor working in kurtosis 😅 Looks like you need to specify `dora_params`. See this: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/epbs-devnet-0#Kurtosis-Interop-Conifg-Pre-devnet-testing ah okay thanks! No problem 🙂 please share if you get it working! Also, I'm not sure if you can interop with Consensoor. I'd recommend removing that from your config. I believe it has p2p peering issues with real clients. did you fetch the latest dora image? it’s possible we still have some tooling bugs As we are waiting for a real client to ship something to finalized our tooling prs cc <@808969530608451584> this does look like an older dora image possibly cached locally yeah consensoor can’t peer with anyone but itself (other consensoor peers) I have that there as a placeholder till we have the first working client im using `--image-download always` plus the dora params mentioned above. still seeing a few issues, but need to double check a few things on our end. will get back to you soon. a local LH only network seems to be working and finalizing, just need to make a few tweaks before its ready to interop with other clients Nice, congrats that's awesome!

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: Hello, before Gloas, when we receive an attestation for a block root we haven' t seen we request it. When we see a block that builds on a block we haven' t seen we request it. After Gloas, when we receive a block that builds on top of a payload we haven' t seen we request it. What I **haven' t seen specified** is that when we receive an attestation for a past block with index 1 and we do not have the payload, **we should request the payload by root** obtained from the bid from the block. This may actually be more costly than usual.

excerpts.author: potuz
